source: football wourld cup in a 2026 mordern staidium to play football and a 3d screen so theres a lobby and people vote for a country and two countrys are chosen and than people choose what country they wanna play as and make sure it's not on base plate and it's in a staidiam

image_prompt.text: Painted touchlines and goal lines marking the boundary of the pitch
Centre circle and penalty spots where the ball and players reset to start play
Goal mouths at each end of the pitch
Pitch markings denoting spatial progress - halfway line, penalty areas, corner arcs
The outer stadium wall closing the ground off and containing the ball and players
Large tiered stands framing all four sides of the pitch, giving the modern stadium its scale and enclosure
A spacious lobby off the stadium where the whole server gathers to vote before the match
a large 3D screen in the lobby showing the countries being voted on

layout_placement.text: Detection perimeter around the pitch so play resets the moment the ball crosses a line
Kickoff and restart positions for ball and players
Goal volumes that register a score when the ball crosses the line

notes: Preset caveat from the Sports file: bleacher height must be captured explicitly or the stadium builds completely flat, and regulation pitch dimensions are a known spec better placed parametrically than generated.
Sports has no lobby option; social-hub was taken from Party & Casual as a secondary-genre option, without taking its lobby-and-stage shape.
User constraint: the build must not sit on a baseplate - the ground surface has to be stadium floor and surrounds.

open_questions.ask: Is the lobby attached to the stadium as one map, or a separate place players teleport out of when the match starts?
How does a match end - fixed timer, first to a score, or full-length halves?

coverage_missing.ask: Should the lobby and the pitch be one continuous map, or two separated areas?
Full regulation pitch, or a shortened arcade pitch that fits more of the stadium on screen?
How many players per side, and what ends the match?

answers.ask: Is the lobby attached to the stadium as one map, or a separate place players teleport out of when the match starts?
answers.answer: Make the lobby attached to the modern 2026 stadium as one map, so players can vote and then go straight into the stadium match.

answers.ask: How does a match end - fixed timer, first to a score, or full-length halves?
answers.answer: Use a fixed short match timer for a simple playable game; the team with the most goals when time ends wins.
